p: Tony Stark's miniature clean-energy core. It kept him alive and powers every Iron Man suit.
Suits from the Mark 50 onward form instantly from a housing unit and shape weapons on demand.
Wakanda's near-indestructible, energy-absorbing metal. It makes Cap's shield and powers a nation.
Shrink or enlarge any matter. The key that unlocked Quantum Realm time travel.
Drone-projected holograms convincing enough to fake a multiverse.
TemPads, reset charges and pruning devices that operate outside of time itself.
A vibranium disc carried by Steve Rogers, and now Sam Wilson's responsibility.
Thor's enchanted hammer and the axe forged in Infinity War. Only the worthy can lift Mjolnir.
The ancient rings worn by Wenwu and later his son Shang-Chi. Their origin is still a mystery.
